items.name: Arcjet AI security models
items.description: A family of custom-trained security models for coding agents. Arcjet is launching a family of custom AI security models designed for analyzing AI agent activity: Arcjet Himalia 1, a general purpose prompt injection model, live today for every SDK call that uses prompt injection detection, and specialist versions designed for situations that general models handle badly, Arcjet Thebe 1 for coding agents, and Arcjet Carme 1, for autonomous security agents.

items.name: ProtoMap
items.description: Stop wasting AI tokens rediscovering dependencies. ProtoMap helps engineers and AI coding agents understand how services, APIs, and data fields depend on each other across large codebases. It builds a deterministic dependency map for gRPC and Protobuf systems, updated on every commit and accessible through a web app or MCP. Instead of wasting time and tokens searching code across repositories, agents query ProtoMap directly to understand change impact. One enterprise team reduced change-planning time and tokens by 8×.

raw_data.tagline: Stop wasting AI tokens rediscovering dependencies

items.name: Cognition SWE-2 Flash
items.description: Cognition’s fast coding model, 3x the speed of SWE-2. SWE-2 Flash is Cognition’s new coding model, built on Thinking Machines’ Inkling-Small with 276B total and 12B active parameters. Per Cognition, it generates about 200 tokens per second, 3x the speed of SWE-2 at one-fifth the price, and scores 20.0% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, up from 0.9% for the base model. Try it in Devin Desktop and Devin CLI, free through 11/30. Weights are not public yet.

items.name: Chronos Gateway
items.description: The firewall between AI agents and your production data. AI agents have already wiped production databases. Chronos Gateway is how you let yours write to real customer data anyway.
